Pinball Drop.name: Pinball Drop
Pinball Drop.description: The user goes feather-light to kick off walls, pillars and ceilings in rapid rebounding bounds across a street or up a shaft, then shifts to heavy weight in the final instant of landing on a target. The drop deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target flat; held back, the user lands beside them and only bowls them off balance. Rapid weight shifts with every bounce leave the user nauseated. Strain: moderate.
